scope: Tesla Charge Companion V9 German CPO first-pass

this_pass.evidence: Current first-party public charging page explicitly identifies Stadtwerke Barth as CPO and publishes anonymous ad-hoc charging without contract by QR/card at EUR 0.50/kWh AC. Customer Premium-Ladekarte price is EUR 0.43/kWh with EUR 2.50/month from 2026-07-01. Blocking fee is EUR 0.10/min after 360 minutes from session start between 09:00 and 18:00. Third-party roaming prices remain variable and separate.
this_pass.policy: Cooperation with Stadtwerke Stralsund for backend/card acceptance is not treated as an operator alias; Barth remains the physical CPO for its published sites.

this_pass.evidence: Current first-party page confirms 10 public 22 kW AC charge points commissioned since March 2024 and offers Direct Payment without contract, eCharge+ and RFID. Multiple current station-level records attribute the EVSEs to Stadtwerke Ribnitz-Damgarten and expose EUR 0.77/kWh direct payment, but the first-party page does not publish that numeric amount in retrievable text; therefore the sampled value is not promoted network-wide.
this_pass.reason: ad-hoc and physical CPO ownership are first-party confirmed; exact current numeric direct tariff is only corroborated station-level, not authoritatively published network-wide

this_pass.evidence: The dedicated m8mit tenant identifies Stadtwerke Güstrow GmbH as Ladepunktbetreiber and lists current EVSEs DE*GCB*E5600 through E5603. The same public tenant confirms spontaneous charging by app/QR/SMS with Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, credit card or mobile-phone billing. Tariff fields are dynamically loaded and no exact numeric price is exposed in retrievable authoritative text. Household/private-wallbox E-Mobil electricity prices were explicitly excluded.
this_pass.reason: operator, EVSEs and anonymous payment are verified, but exact current per-EVSE tariff is dynamically loaded and not safely retrievable

this_pass.evidence: The dedicated m8mit tenant lists DE*MSU*EPCH*WW10 at Ostring 5 with two 22 kW connectors and explicitly names Stadtwerke Parchim GmbH as Ladepunktbetreiber. Public spontaneous charging is supported by app/QR/SMS with common direct payment methods. Tariff fields are dynamically loaded; a current discovery source reports EUR 0.40/kWh at a Parchim site, but because that value is not exposed by the authoritative tenant in retrievable text it is not promoted as operator-wide pricing.
this_pass.reason: exact authoritative dynamic tariff not retrievable; third-party EUR 0.40/kWh remains discovery evidence only

this_pass.evidence: Current first-party e-mobility page lists the utility's own public charging locations at August-Bebel-Straße 4, Grüner Weg 27, Am Bahnhof 1 and Klützer Straße 27, including AC and DC equipment. A current station record at Klützer Straße reports contract/RFID-only access and no ad-hoc price, so no tariff is inferred from roaming products.
this_pass.reason: physical CPO scope is first-party documented but no current exact own-network direct tariff is published

this_pass.evidence: Current station directories identify public charge points in Waren (Müritz) under Stadtwerke Waren GmbH / Stadtwerke Waren. The current first-party website documents charging-infrastructure grid services but does not expose a public CPO tariff or direct-payment matrix. Domestic electricity and grid-control tariffs were excluded from public-charging pricing.
this_pass.reason: public stations are discoverable under the operator identity, but current authoritative public-charging tariff/payment semantics are missing

this_pass.evidence: Current station-level registry material attributes a public AC/DC charging installation at An den Stadtwerken 2, Pasewalk to Stadtwerke Pasewalk GmbH. The current first-party site and Infocenter publish 2026 energy/network material but no public-charging tariff matrix or current direct-payment conditions. Household, business and network electricity tariffs were excluded.
this_pass.reason: CPO identity is supported by station records, but no current exact authoritative public-charging tariff or checkout surface was found
